# TelegaFirst Hub API — LLM Reference

## Overview
The Hub API exposes TelegaFirst commerce, auth, and catalog data to external applications and MCP agents. All endpoints are versioned under `/api/v1`. Discovery endpoints (`/guide`, `/me`, `/openapi.json`) remain accessible to introspect the currently authenticated app.

## Authentication
- `X-Api-Key: tgf_api_<secret>` — server-to-server API key.
- `Authorization: Bearer <jwt>` — user-scoped JWT (from `/sessions/exchange`).
- `tgf_test_` prefix selects sandbox mode.

## Endpoints
### /api/v1/users
- `GET /api/v1/users` _(scopes: pull:users)_ — List tenant users by their local sequence
- `GET /api/v1/users/{seq_id}` _(scopes: pull:users)_ — Read a tenant user and permitted relation projections

### /api/v1/payments
- `GET /api/v1/payments` _(scopes: pull:payments)_ — List tenant payments using safe related sequences
- `GET /api/v1/payments/{seq_id}` _(scopes: pull:payments)_ — Read a tenant payment by its local sequence

### /api/v1/tools
- `POST /api/v1/tools/sales/manual-sales` _(scopes: orders:write)_ — Create a manual sale from either buyer/catalogue sequences or one registration sequence. REST retains catalogue pricing; it does not accept MCP price overrides. Idempotency-Key must contain a non-whitespace character. The durable 30-day receipt is keyed by client, operation and key; replay rechecks actor admission and returns the stored result with replayed=true.
- `GET /api/v1/tools/external-content-publish/{draftHandle}` _(scopes: content:read)_ — Read the full draft lifecycle and finalized media
- `DELETE /api/v1/tools/external-content-publish/{draftHandle}` _(scopes: content:write)_ — Cancel a pending content draft
- `GET /api/v1/tools/statuses` _(scopes: statuses:read)_ — List the tenant order-status set
- `POST /api/v1/tools/statuses` _(scopes: statuses:write)_ — Create an order status
- `PATCH /api/v1/tools/statuses` _(scopes: statuses:write)_ — Update an order status by tenant sequence
- `POST /api/v1/tools/statuses/delete` _(scopes: statuses:write)_ — Soft-delete an order status by tenant sequence
- `GET /api/v1/tools/quick-replies` _(scopes: quick-replies:read)_ — List the tenant’s operator quick replies
- `POST /api/v1/tools/quick-replies` _(scopes: quick-replies:write)_ — Create an operator quick reply

- `POST /api/v1/tools/quick-replies/delete` _(scopes: quick-replies:write)_ — Delete an operator quick reply by tenant sequence

### /api/v1/sales
- `POST /api/v1/sales/orders/{orderSeqNum}/invoice` _(scopes: orders:write)_ — Queue the transaction-bound invoice dispatch plan for a tenant-local order. queued acknowledges the durable plan; buyer delivery is outbox-owned. Idempotency-Key must contain a non-whitespace character. The durable 30-day receipt is keyed by client, operation and key; replay rechecks actor admission and returns the stored result with replayed=true.
- `POST /api/v1/sales/orders/{orderSeqNum}/mark-paid` _(scopes: orders:write)_ — Record an actual cash, bank transfer or transfer settlement after an explicit switch to manual payment. paymentSeqNum is null when no new payment was recorded. Idempotency-Key must contain a non-whitespace character. The durable 30-day receipt is keyed by client, operation and key; replay rechecks actor admission and returns the stored result with replayed=true.

## Events
Domain events are delivered via webhook (HMAC-SHA256 signed) and SSE.
- `order.created` — Order was created (paid or pending).
- `order.updated` — Order status transitioned.
- `order.linked` — Anonymous order linked to a user.
- `order.expired` — Order expired without payment.
- `payment.succeeded` — Payment reached succeeded state.
- `payment.failed` — Payment moved to failed.
- `payment.refunded` — Payment refunded (full or partial).
- `subscription.updated` — Subscription state changed.
- `subscription.canceled` — Subscription canceled by user or provider.
- `subscription.renewed` — Subscription auto-renewed.
- `subscription.expired` — Subscription expired.
- `catalog.created` — Catalog entry created.
- `catalog.updated` — Catalog entry updated (any field).
- `catalog.deleted` — Catalog entry deleted. Includes soft-delete (is_deleted=true) — the item stops being purchasable, which is what a subscriber cares about.
- `user.created` — User registered.
- `user.session.approved` — Approval session approved by user in Telegram.
- `user.session.denied` — Approval session denied.
- `user.session.expired` — Approval session expired.
- `button.clicked` — Interactive button clicked inside Telegram.
- `webhook.auto_disabled` — App webhook auto-disabled after consecutive failures.
- `support.escalated` — Support session escalated to human operator.

## Rate limits
Rate limits are per API key. Tiers: free (60 rpm), starter (300), pro (600), enterprise (1200+). Headers `X-RateLimit-Limit`, `X-RateLimit-Remaining`, `X-RateLimit-Reset` and `Retry-After` indicate current state.

## Error codes
- `VALIDATION_ERROR` (400) — Zod validation failure.
- `UNAUTHENTICATED` (401) — missing or invalid credentials.
- `FORBIDDEN` (403) — scope or zone mismatch.
- `NOT_FOUND` (404) — resource unknown.
- `CONFLICT` (409) — state transition or idempotency conflict.
- `RATE_LIMITED` (429) — per-key or per-IP rate limit exceeded.
- `INTERNAL` (500) — unexpected server error.
